old_caption:
The video captures a woman dancing in a dance studio. She is wearing a black sleeveless top, a leopard-print skirt, and black ankle boots. Her hair is long and dark, tied back in a ponytail. The studio has white walls and a large mirror covering one wall, reflecting her movements. The floor is light-colored, possibly wooden or laminate. The lighting is bright, coming from ceiling fixtures, which illuminate the space evenly.

Initially, she stands facing the mirror, her hands on her hips, and begins to move rhythmically. She extends her arms out to the sides, then brings them up to her head, mimicking a dance pose. Her movements are fluid and expressive, suggesting she is practicing a choreographed routine. As she dances, she shifts her weight from side to side, maintaining a confident posture throughout. The camera remains stationary, capturing her full body and the reflection in the mirror, providing a clear view of her dance movements and the studio environment.

caption:
The video captures a woman dancing in a studio with white walls, a pale wood floor, ceiling track lights and a wall air-conditioning unit. She stands with her back to the camera, facing a full-height mirror. The reversed figure in the glass is her reflection, not a second person. In a black sleeveless top and a ruffled leopard-print skirt, one hand rests on her hip as her other arm, bent low, swings outward to the left.

The arm lifts, sweeping from horizontal into a steep diagonal and then straight overhead. As it rises, her head and torso turn slightly. Her ponytail and skirt ruffles sway with the movement. The raised hand shifts from an open, spread-finger palm into a pointing gesture with the index finger extended. The mirror tracks every change, its reflected arm climbing and its hand reshaping in step. Her feet stay largely planted, with only small weight shifts, so she does not travel. The clip opens mid-sweep and closes while the raised, pointing arm is still held in motion.

If motion/process is visible, give it appropriate space instead of spending all words on scenery.
Never invent events, locations, object counts, hidden causes, precise timings, continued stillness
